name: gameshelf
description: Root task runner. Every script works from any shell (cmd, PowerShell, Git Bash, CI).

scripts.setup: dotnet tool restore && dotnet restore GameShelf.sln && npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web run playwright:install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:up && dotnet run --project src/GameShelf.Api
scripts.build: dotnet build GameShelf.sln && npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web run lint && npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:backend:unit && npm run test:backend:integration
scripts.test:backend:integration: npm run db:up && dotnet test tests/GameShelf.Api.IntegrationTests
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:up && npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web run test:e2e
scripts.test:docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile backend --profile frontend --profile e2e down --volumes --remove-orphans
scripts.bicep:build: az bicep build --file infra/bicep/main.bicep && az bicep build-params --file infra/bicep/env/dev.bicepparam
